lane: external non-self-generated evaluation surface — STALE memory-system mode
relation_to_prior_freezes: NEW protocol with its own falsifiers. The frozen 7B/A100 four-arm protocol and its BLOCKED_ON_CAPABILITY_QUALIFICATION terminal remain on record verbatim and are not substituted into. The published STALE full-context protocol is separately receipted infeasible (research/paper3_stale_feasibility_v1/FEASIBILITY_RECEIPT.json).
question: On externally constructed staleness scenarios ingested incrementally, does typed invalidation governance with refusal semantics (ON) over an identical extracted memory store change judge-scored answer correctness versus naive retrieval (OFF) at matched answer-time budget?

subject_selection_rule.rule: largest Qwen2.5 instruct model whose Q4_K_M weights plus an 8,192-token KV cache and runtime overhead fit the sanctioned 6 GB RTX A3000 with deterministic decoding, serving as both target and arm-blind judge without reload
subject_selection_rule.rejected_alternative: qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q4_K_M (~4.7 GB weights) rejected in advance: weights + 8K KV + CUDA overhead runs at the VRAM boundary and an OOM fallback to CPU offload mid-run would silently unmatch the arms' budgets

dataset.source: huggingface.co/datasets/STALEproj/STALE refs/convert/parquet train shard (288,947,099 bytes, 400 rows, CC BY 4.0), already on billy-laptop at ~/stale-feas/stale_train.parquet
dataset.split_rule: rows ordered by sha256(uid) ascending; probe subset = first 8 rows; confirmatory subset = next 40 rows; remaining 352 rows untouched
dataset.judge_gold_reference: the judge (scorer, not candidate) sees M_new and explanation as gold reference; the judge never sees which arm produced a response

arms.shared_ingestion: one extraction pass per scenario: each haystack session is passed to the subject model with a fixed fact-extraction prompt producing (attribute, value) records tagged with session index and timestamp; the identical store feeds both arms — extraction quality is held fixed so exactly one dimension (governance) varies
arms.TYPED_ON: attributes canonicalized; per-attribute chains ordered by session time; a later different value invalidates predecessors (version_current=false); answers are generated from current-valid relevant facts only, with a fixed instruction that earlier contradicting states are invalidated and stale premises must be corrected; no relevant valid fact => the answer must state the information is not known (refusal semantics)
arms.NAIVE_OFF: top-k retrieval over all extracted facts by the same lexical scorer, no chains, no invalidation, no staleness instruction, direct answer
arms.matched_budget: same retrieval k=8, same model, same decoding limits, exactly one model call per query per arm

admissibility_probe_before_confirmatory.mechanic: oracle-ceiling admissibility (absorbed Paper IV mechanic) applied prospectively
admissibility_probe_before_confirmatory.SKYLINE: answers generated with gold explanation visible to the responder
admissibility_probe_before_confirmatory.FLOOR: answers generated with no memory and no haystack
admissibility_probe_before_confirmatory.gate: on the 8-scenario probe subset, judge-scored dim1 accuracy must satisfy SKYLINE - FLOOR >= 0.30 and SKYLINE >= 0.60, else terminal INSTRUMENT_INADMISSIBLE_CEILING_BELOW_GATE and the confirmatory subset is not spent
admissibility_probe_before_confirmatory.judge_control: on every probe scenario the judge must score the SKYLINE answer pattern correct and a planted anti-gold answer incorrect; judge known-answer agreement must be >= 0.90 or the terminal is JUDGE_UNRELIABLE_CANNOT_CHECK

falsifiability_audit_before_confirmatory: every registered confirmatory gate condition is audited per condition with src/rakl/gate_falsifiability.py over the probe-set evidence rows (perturbations include judge-verdict shuffle, gold-reference shuffle, dimension drops, response/row misalignment); any NON_FALSIFIABLE condition disqualifies the gate before the confirmatory subset is read

confirmatory_gates.G1_coverage: every dimension has >= 30 scorable queries per arm
confirmatory_gates.G2_judge_known_answer: judge known-answer agreement >= 0.90 on planted controls
confirmatory_gates.G3_primary_contrast: ON - OFF overall judge accuracy reported with sign and bootstrap 95% CI
confirmatory_gates.positive_terminal_requires: ON - OFF >= +0.10 overall AND CI excluding 0 AND no dimension where ON < OFF - 0.05
confirmatory_gates.negative_terminal: TYPED_GOVERNANCE_EXTERNAL_SURFACE_NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_ENVELOPE — files with single-stage attribution and exactly one registered revival attempt (global-recovery doctrine); the revival lever must be named from the attribution, not tuned post hoc
confirmatory_gates.null_terminal: CI includes 0 => INCONCLUSIVE_IN_ENVELOPE, reported as such

honesty_clauses: the published 55.2% ceiling is never a comparator; no leaderboard claim of any kind
a floor-regime result (both arms near 0) after a passed admissibility probe is reported as measured, not suppressed
no threshold, subset, prompt or judge change after first confirmatory outcome access
all prompts are frozen in the harness at the registration commit; the harness commit precedes probe execution in branch history
